ITEM 1 | White, opaque, crumbly-textured mass of irregular small curds and chunks, matte surface with slight moisture, spread across the left half of the plate in an irregular mound about 12 cm wide and 14 cm long, roughly 2 cm tall on average, with some bits up to 3 cm high | 260
ITEM 2 | Orange-to-amber cubes with slightly darker browned edges and some caramelized spots, firm with a smooth, slightly glossy exterior, pieces about 2-3 cm per side, arranged in a cluster on the upper right of the plate, roughly 2 cm tall | 150
ITEM 3 | Bright red fruit pieces with a pinkish-red flesh and darker red edges, cut into irregular cubes about 2-2.5 cm per side, moist and juicy looking with slight sheen, arranged in a cluster on the lower right of the plate, about 1.5-2 cm tall | 130
